purpose: Resolve the six P2C staged catalog offers into exact source-scoped canonical identities using the existing schema, without treating seller claims as independent verification of material authenticity, grade, treatment, origin or ethics.
semantic_boundary: A canonical material/category identity is not a claim that a specific supplier item is authentic or correctly graded.
All supplier-product material labels remain source-stated and unverified at product level.
Do not infer treatment, geological provenance, ethical sourcing, certification, bead count, landed cost, stock continuity or trade discount.
Public catalog prices remain benchmark offer prices at the stated unit basis and VAT basis.
No user preference, design pattern, theme or product-concept judgment is authored by this mapping.

promotion_policy.review_decision_policy: Do not fabricate a human review. Use existing project promotion mechanics without inserting a human review_decision unless the existing importer contract strictly requires one; if it does, stop and report that local process requirement instead of pretending a person reviewed the offer.
promotion_policy.indicative_material_variant_price_policy: Do not copy strand or piece catalog prices into material_variant.indicative_price_minor because that field lacks the supplier unit basis. Keep prices in supplier_offer.

expected_business_effect.purpose: Create the first exact catalog benchmark layer that can support later BOM-cost comparisons without choosing a production supplier or sourcing geography.
